Cohort Replication and Heterogeneity Profile

Source: R/replication.R
stabl_replication_profile.Rd

Characterizes cross-cohort replication of feature selection: pooled selection stability, training-cohort replication across leave-one-study-out fits, leave-one-study-out sensitivity of the pooled panel, optional direction/effect replication from user-supplied per-study effect estimates, and optional held-out cohort performance via a documented downstream-refit design.

Usage

stabl_replication_profile(
  x,
  y,
  study_labels,
  fit_spec = list(),
  pooled_fit = NULL,
  effects = NULL,
  heldout_performance = FALSE,
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

Numeric predictor matrix with non-empty row names (sample ids) and column names (feature ids), as for stabl_fit().

y

Outcome vector, named to match rownames(x).

study_labels

Named vector (factor-coercible) assigning each sample to a study/cohort; names must match rownames(x) exactly. At least three studies are required.

fit_spec

Named list of further arguments for stabl_fit(), e.g. list(n_bootstraps = 50, artificial_type = "knockoff_equi"). The per-fit random_state is always set by stabl_replication_profile; lambda_grid defaults to "auto" when not supplied.

pooled_fit

Optional pre-computed pooled stabl_fit() result on (x, y); validated for feature-name agreement and refitted if absent.

effects

Optional data frame with columns feature, study, estimate, se giving per-study effect estimates for direction replication. Estimates must come from a documented per-study estimation design; they are used as supplied. Duplicated (feature, study) rows are an error.

heldout_performance

Logical; if TRUE, evaluate each LOSO fold's selected panel on the held-out study via a downstream stats::glm() refit (gaussian: MSE; binomial: balanced error rate). Empty panels contribute NA with reason "empty_support".

seed

Optional base seed for the per-fit derived seeds (recorded; fully replayable). If NULL, drawn from the current RNG state and recorded.

...

Reserved; unused arguments are an error.

Value

A stabl_replication_profile object: a list with

features

Per-feature data frame: n_measured_cohorts, n_eligible_cohorts, within_study_frequency, training_replication, fold_frequency, in_pooled_support, loso_retention, dropped_on_removal_of, and (when effects is supplied) n_estimates, sign_concordance, pooled_estimate, pooled_se, pooled_ci_lo, pooled_ci_hi, het_Q, het_df, het_p.

estimands

Named list describing the four estimands and where each lives in the output.

pooled_support

Character vector of the pooled selected panel.

heldout

When heldout_performance = TRUE, a per-study data frame of held-out metrics with reason for NAs.

eligibility

Per feature-by-cohort eligibility with reason for ineligibility ("all_missing", "constant_in_cohort").

study_labels, fit_spec, seed, fit_seeds, call

Provenance.

Interpretation caveat

The four estimands answer different questions. Selection agreement across cohorts is not evidence of causal or directional agreement; direction/effect replication is only as valid as the supplied per-study estimation design. Proportions are cohort-level observations over dependent folds – no binomial confidence intervals are computed.

Examples

set.seed(1)
ids <- paste0("s", 1:60)
x <- matrix(rnorm(60 * 8), 60, 8,
            dimnames = list(ids, paste0("f", 1:8)))
y <- setNames(x[, 1] * 3 + rnorm(60, sd = 0.8), ids)
studies <- setNames(rep(paste0("study", 1:3), each = 20L), ids)
rp <- stabl_replication_profile(
  x, y, studies,
  fit_spec = list(n_bootstraps = 50,
                  artificial_type = "random_permutation"),
  seed = 5
)
head(rp$features)
#>   feature n_measured_cohorts n_eligible_cohorts within_study_frequency
#> 1      f1                  3                  3              1.0000000
#> 2      f2                  3                  3              1.0000000
#> 3      f3                  3                  3              1.0000000
#> 4      f4                  3                  3              0.3333333
#> 5      f5                  3                  3              1.0000000
#> 6      f6                  3                  3              0.3333333
#>   training_replication fold_frequency in_pooled_support loso_retention
#> 1            1.0000000      1.0000000              TRUE      1.0000000
#> 2            0.6666667      0.6666667              TRUE      0.6666667
#> 3            1.0000000      1.0000000              TRUE      1.0000000
#> 4            0.6666667      0.6666667             FALSE             NA
#> 5            0.6666667      0.6666667              TRUE      0.6666667
#> 6            0.3333333      0.3333333              TRUE      0.3333333
#>   dropped_on_removal_of
#> 1                  <NA>
#> 2                study1
#> 3                  <NA>
#> 4                  <NA>
#> 5                study3
#> 6         study1,study3
